definitions: The forward-most part or surface of something.
A line where two opposing armies meet.
A person or organization used to conceal an illegal or secret activity.
A boundary between two air masses of different temperatures.
examples: The front of the car was damaged.
Soldiers were sent to the front.
She's working on a new front in her research.
The cafe was just a front for their drug operation.
A cold front is moving in.
